invented_facts: The battery test used the 8B model; the paper specifies only continuous local language model inference.
Larger models require the 128 GB high-memory configuration; the tested 30B model also ran on the 32 GB Aurora 14 and 64 GB Vantage Pro 16.
Sustained workloads generally slow by 9–12% after 20 minutes; the sustained test covered only the 8B model.
notes: The VP-level framing is clear and the summary meets the length and bullet requirements. It omits required caveats and test conditions, notably the single Vantage configuration, 4-bit quantization and unevaluated output quality, and the battery rating’s 150-nit, Wi-Fi-off conditions.
